# langfuse_evaluation_rule (Resource)

Manages an evaluation rule in a Langfuse project using the stable evaluation-rules API (`/api/public/v2/evaluation-rules`). A rule defines which incoming observations are evaluated, by which evaluators, how often, and how prompt variables are populated. Rules always use the latest version of each assigned evaluator.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Evaluate half of all production generations with two evaluators.
resource "langfuse_evaluation_rule" "production_generations" {
  project_public_key = local.langfuse_project_public_key
  project_secret_key = local.langfuse_project_secret_key

  name     = "Production generations"
  enabled  = true
  sampling = 0.5

  # Omit filter to match every incoming observation.
  filter = [
    {
      type     = "stringOptions"
      column   = "type"
      operator = "any of"
      values   = ["GENERATION"]
    },
    {
      type     = "string"
      column   = "promptName"
      operator = "="
      value    = "chat-answer"
    },
    {
      type     = "stringObject"
      column   = "metadata"
      key      = "tenant"
      operator = "="
      value    = "acme"
    },
  ]

  evaluator_assignments = [
    {
      # Inherits the evaluator's default variable_mapping.
      evaluator_id = langfuse_evaluator.helpfulness.id
    },
    {
      evaluator_id = langfuse_evaluator.tone.id
      # Rule-specific mapping: every variable of the evaluator must appear exactly once.
      variable_mapping = [
        { variable = "output", source = "metadata", json_path = "$.final_answer" },
      ]
    },
    {
      # Code evaluators use a fixed runtime mapping; do not set variable_mapping.
      evaluator_id = langfuse_evaluator.answer_length.id
    },
  ]
}

# Draft rule: disabled rules may omit evaluator_assignments.
resource "langfuse_evaluation_rule" "experiment_draft" {
  project_public_key = local.langfuse_project_public_key
  project_secret_key = local.langfuse_project_secret_key

  name    = "Experiment runs (draft)"
  enabled = false

  filter = [
    {
      type     = "stringOptions"
      column   = "datasetId" # dataset ID, not the dataset name
      operator = "any of"
      values   = ["cm1dataset000000000000000"]
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether live execution is enabled. An enabled rule requires at least one evaluator assignment.
- `name` (String) Human-readable rule name. Names are not identifiers and do not need to be unique.
- `project_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The project public key used to authenticate API calls.
- `project_secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The project secret key used to authenticate API calls.

### Optional

- `evaluator_assignments` (Attributes List) Evaluators attached to this rule. Required (at least one) when `enabled` is `true`; a disabled rule may omit it as a draft. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--evaluator_assignments))
- `filter` (Attributes List) Conditions used to select observations. Omit to match every incoming observation. Scalar conditions use `value`; option conditions (`stringOptions`, `arrayOptions`, `categoryOptions`) use `values`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
- `sampling` (Number) Fraction of matching observations to evaluate, between `0` and `1`. Defaults to `1`, which evaluates every match.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The stable identifier of the evaluation rule.

<a id="nestedatt--evaluator_assignments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `evaluator_assignments`

Required:

- `evaluator_id` (String) Stable evaluator identifier. The rule automatically uses that evaluator's latest version.

Optional:

- `variable_mapping` (Attributes List) Rule-specific prompt-variable mapping overriding the evaluator's default mapping. Omit to inherit the default. Code evaluators use a fixed runtime mapping and must omit it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--evaluator_assignments--variable_mapping))

<a id="nestedatt--evaluator_assignments--variable_mapping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `evaluator_assignments.variable_mapping`

Required:

- `source` (String) Observation field that populates the variable. Valid values: `input`, `output`, `metadata`, `tool_calls`, `expected_output`, `experiment_item_metadata`.
- `variable` (String) Prompt variable name without braces. For the prompt `Judge {{input}}` use `input`.

Optional:

- `json_path` (String) Optional JSONPath selector, for example `$.answer`, applied to the source before it is inserted into the prompt. Validated by the API.



<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `column` (String) Observation column to filter on. The API accepts a fixed set of column/type pairs, for example `type`, `name`, `level`, `traceName`, `experimentId`, `datasetId` (dataset ID, not name) with `stringOptions`; `version`, `release`, `statusMessage`, `providedModelName`, `promptName`, `userId`, `sessionId`, `experimentName` with `string`; `promptVersion`, `toolCalls` with `number`; `tags`, `calledToolNames` with `arrayOptions`; `metadata` with `stringObject`; `isRootObservation`, `isExperimentItemRootSpan` with `boolean`; `parentObservationId` with `null`.
- `operator` (String) Comparison operator, for example `=`, `contains`, `>`, `any of`, `none of`, `all of`, `<>`, `is null`, `is not null`. Valid operators depend on `type`.
- `type` (String) Filter type. Valid values: `datetime`, `string`, `number`, `stringOptions`, `categoryOptions`, `arrayOptions`, `stringObject`, `numberObject`, `boolean`, `null`.

Optional:

- `key` (String) Key inside an object-valued column. Required for `stringObject`, `numberObject` and `categoryOptions`.
- `value` (String) Scalar comparison value as a string. Numbers (`number`, `numberObject`) and booleans (`boolean`) are parsed from this string. Datetimes are RFC 3339. Not used for option types or `null`.
- `values` (List of String) Option values for `stringOptions`, `arrayOptions` and `categoryOptions`. Not used for other types.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import ID format: <project_public_key>:<project_secret_key>:<evaluation_rule_id>
terraform import langfuse_evaluation_rule.production_generations "pk-lf-...:sk-lf-...:cm1rule000000000000000000"
```
